processes.name: Airflow scheduler
processes.description: Lists and reads files from the landing bucket, retains connection strings and partner keys through its metadata database, and triggers Spark transform jobs.

data_stores.name: Airflow metadata database
data_stores.description: Airflow database containing connection strings and partner keys.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Airflow keeps its connection strings and the partner keys in its own metadata database.
data_stores.notes: The source says: "I don't know how the landing bucket is encrypted or whether the Airflow metadata database is encrypted at rest. Both are on defaults as far as I know."

data_stores.name: BigQuery
data_stores.source_excerpt: The transform normalizes the records and loads them into BigQuery.
